scripts.build: pnpm --filter @pi-desktop/protocol build && pnpm --filter @pi-desktop/database build && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.web.json --noEmit && vite build
scripts.package:dir: pnpm rebuild:native && pnpm build && electron-builder --mac dir --config electron-builder.yml --publish never --config.mac.identity=null --config.mac.hardenedRuntime=false --config.mac.notarize=false
scripts.package:dmg: pnpm rebuild:native && pnpm build && electron-builder --mac dmg --config electron-builder.yml --publish never --config.mac.identity=null --config.mac.hardenedRuntime=false --config.mac.notarize=false
scripts.package:win:dir: pnpm rebuild:native && pnpm build && electron-builder --win dir --x64 --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.package:win: pnpm rebuild:native && pnpm build && electron-builder --win nsis zip --x64 --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
